Eurovision-inspired toy ranking data

Source: R/toy_rankings.R
eurovision_toy.Rd

A synthetic preference-ranking dataset for a song-contest setting. Two latent voting profiles produce different rankings of eight fictional acts. It is designed to demonstrate pl_mixture_model() without redistributing data from a real contest.

Usage

eurovision_toy(n_rankings = 40L, rank_length = 5L, seed = 2030L)

Arguments

n_rankings

Number of synthetic jury or viewer rankings.

rank_length

Number of reported positions per ranking.

seed

Integer seed.

Value

A btsbm_ranking_data object. Its truth attribute contains the synthetic voter-group labels and generating latent strengths.
